data.exact_reserve_text: The contribution from the run off years' gross reserve release was GBP 16.2 million (2013: GBP 16.9 million) which relates to improvements to the incurred claims position predominantly in the Third Party Liability Account of GBP 7.4 million (2013: GBP 10.7 million) and RI acceptances of GBP 4.2 million (2013: GBP 4.2 million).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 137.475m. During 2014 there was a gross prior-year reserve release of GBP 16.2m (around 11.8% of opening gross reserves), driven principally by favourable development in the Third Party Liability account and beneficial movement on reinsurance acceptances.
raw_causal_phrases: run off years' gross reserve release
improvements to the incurred claims position
releases from major claims issues such as Italian Medical Malpractice
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) - high confidence. Prior-year movement (GBP 16.2m release) quoted explicitly in Managing Agent's Results section - high confidence. Segmental premium mix extracted from the segmental analysis table but several small direct-class numbers were difficult to read in the scanned image; a number of minor class amounts were estimated to make the direct insurance subtotal match the printed total. No claims development triangle or a 'movement in prior year's provision' reconciliation table with a gross column was found in scanned pages accessible; used narrative gross prior-year release as primary source.
